question: A bar magnet is moved towards a coil connected to a galvanometer and then held stationary near the coil. Explain the galvanometer observations in both cases. Give reason.

options.A: The galvanometer shows no deflection while the magnet moves, but a continuous deflection when it is stationary.
options.B: The galvanometer shows continuous deflection in both cases because the magnet produces a magnetic field.
options.C: The galvanometer shows a momentary deflection while the magnet moves towards the coil because the flux changes; it shows no deflection when the magnet is held stationary because the flux is constant.
options.D: The galvanometer deflects only after the magnet has been held stationary for some time.
